g.title: crate Styles, lengths, colors, themes and the drawing vocabulary.
crate::asset Public image and font source values.
crate::color Colors: sRGB, theme tokens or theme-resolved values, resolved at paint.
crate::draw The `Draw` painter: shapes, paths, text, images, layers and canvas regions.
crate::draw::image Image values for the painter: pixel buffers and drawing options.
crate::draw::layer Closure-scoped canvas groups in the element style vocabulary.
crate::draw::paragraph Shaped paragraphs: measured once, queried for geometry and drawn as shaped.
crate::effect Shapes, shadows, filters and blending, and their engine forms.
crate::geometry Geometry values: points, sizes, rectangles and corner radii.
crate::grid CSS Grid tracks and item placement.
crate::icon Name an icon by meaning or by its image, as plain data.
crate::length Layout units: pixels, percentages, fractions.
crate::paint Fills: colors, gradients and images, and the engine's fill layers.
crate::paint::canvas_gradient Gradients placed by canvas coordinates: linear, two-circle radial and conic.
crate::path Reusable canvas paths in the shared shape vocabulary.
crate::path::geometry Path geometry and coordinate operations.
crate::path::outline `Path::stroke_outline`: a line's outline as a path to fill.
crate::path::trim Path length measurement and trimming a path by length.
crate::resolve Style property resolution against the theme into node props.
crate::sheet `Style`: a flat value-type chain and every setter of its properties.
crate::text Text values: spacing, kerning, features, decoration, and their engine forms.
crate::theme Typed theme: token tables for color, spacing, radius, type and focus ring.
crate::theme::value The theme value, its extensions, and the colors resolved in it.
crate::transform Geometric transforms and layout transforms.
